name: Earth Pro
subtitle: Maps, Pins & KML Projects
promotionalText: Paste up to 250 addresses and see them on a map. Customize pins, measure land and distance, add image overlays, and keep your map projects on your Mac.
description:
Turn a list of addresses into a map you can work with. Earth Pro brings a globe, custom pins, KML projects, and precise measurement controls into one native Mac app.

MAP YOUR PLACES
Paste up to 250 addresses, choose a pin color, and plot the matches together. Duplicate lines are skipped, unresolved addresses are listed for correction, and the map frames your results. Search suggestions help you find individual addresses; selecting a result zooms to its highlighted pin.

MAKE THE MAP YOURS
Give placemarks their own colors, shapes, icons, and notes. Draw paths and polygons, organize saved places, and import KML or KMZ projects. Export your places as KML to use elsewhere.

MEASURE WITH THE DETAIL YOU NEED
Measure distances, perimeters, and polygon areas with selectable units and decimal precision. Follow coordinates, approximate elevation, and camera altitude while you explore.

BRING IN MORE CONTEXT
Search geographic layers, compare dated NASA imagery, and position your own image overlays with adjustable bounds, rotation, and opacity. Record silent map videos or save a view as an image.

START WITH FREE MAP PROVIDERS
Explore the globe, Apple Maps, or OpenStreetMap without a Google API key. You can add your own compatible Google Maps API key for Google imagery and photorealistic 3D buildings and terrain where supported. Google may charge separately for API usage.

OPTIONAL LOCAL AI CONTROL
Enable the local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server when you want a compatible LLM client to navigate, work with pins and geometry, plot address lists, manage overlays, or record video. MCP is off by default and uses a session token on your Mac.

Earth Pro needs no app account. Saved places and projects stay on your Mac; online searches, maps, and data use the selected providers. Source code is available under the MIT license, with separate terms for third-party map services and datasets.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Online maps and data require an internet connection. Address matches, 3D coverage, imagery dates, and elevation accuracy vary by provider and location. Historical NASA imagery is a daily satellite archive, not a street-level aerial history. Earth Pro is independently developed and is not affiliated with Google.
reviewNotes:
The app works without an account or Google API key using the built-in globe, Apple Maps, and OpenStreetMap. Optional Google maps and photorealistic 3D require the user's own compatible Google Maps API key in map provider settings. The key is saved locally in macOS Keychain. Local MCP control is disabled by default and must be enabled by the user from the toolbar. Video recording captures the map view without audio. Online map coverage, NASA imagery dates, elevation, and layer data depend on third-party providers.
Test the new address-list feature from Add > Plot Address List. One complete address per line; duplicates are skipped and partial matches are kept. Pin styles can be edited in My Places. Privacy policy and support links are in the Help menu. The open-source license applies to application code; third-party imagery and data retain their own terms.
